result.stdout:
navius - copy-paste component registry for Blazor (Navius)

  navius list
  navius add <name> [--to <dir>] [--namespace <ns>] [--styled-only] [--overwrite] [--root <repo>] [--registry <path>]

  --styled-only  copy only the styled zits/ui + lib files; consume the Navius
                 headless brain as the Navius.Primitives NuGet package instead
                 of vendoring it. Cannot be combined with --namespace.
  --overwrite    replace target files that already exist (default: skip them).
